name: seq_agent_guide
description: Return concise guidance that tells AI agents how to choose Seq MCP tools, recommended workflows, example calls, and safety limits.

name: seq_connection_test
description: Validate Seq connectivity, authentication, resolved API base URL, and host-root health endpoint.

includeApiInfo.description: When true, also fetch the Seq API root document.

name: seq_starter_help
description: List common starter tools and the recommended process for AI agents using this Seq MCP server.

name: seq_starter_overview
description: Run a safe read-only overview: API root, current user, diagnostics status, shared/personal signals, and shared/personal workspaces.

name: seq_starter_events_search
description: Search Seq events with a bounded count, optional Seq filter, signal id/name, UTC time window, and rendered message output.

filter.description: Seq filter expression, for example @Level = 'Error' or RequestPath like '/api%'. Common @Level aliases are expanded.

signal.description: Optional Seq signal id/name to scope the event search.

count.description: Maximum events to return, from 1 to 500. Default 50.

fromDateUtc.description: Inclusive UTC start time, for example 2026-05-11T00:00:00Z.

toDateUtc.description: Exclusive UTC end time, for example 2026-05-11T01:00:00Z.

render.description: When true, ask Seq to include rendered event messages.

name: seq_starter_event_by_id
description: Fetch one Seq event by event id, optionally including rendered message text.

render.description: When true, ask Seq to include rendered event message text.

name: seq_starter_data_query
description: Run a bounded Seq data query using the q language for aggregation, projection, and analysis.

q.description: Seq q query, for example select count(*) as Count from stream. Keep it scoped with time range/count when possible.

signalId.description: Optional signal id to scope the query.

fromDateUtc.description: Inclusive UTC start time, for example 2026-05-11T00:00:00Z.

toDateUtc.description: Exclusive UTC end time, for example 2026-05-11T01:00:00Z.

count.description: Maximum rows/events to return, from 1 to 500. Default 100.

usePost.description: Use POST for long q queries; GET is the default.

name: seq_starter_signals_list
description: List shared and personal Seq signals visible to the configured API key.

name: seq_starter_signal_by_id
description: Fetch one Seq signal by id.

name: seq_starter_dashboards_list
description: List shared and personal Seq dashboards visible to the configured API key.

name: seq_starter_alerts_list
description: List shared and personal Seq alerts visible to the configured API key.

name: seq_starter_events_stream
description: Poll the bounded Seq events stream endpoint for recent/new events with optional filter and signal scope.

filter.description: Optional Seq filter expression for streamed events.

signal.description: Optional Seq signal id/name to scope streamed events.

wait.description: Long-poll wait seconds, from 0 to 30. Default 5.

render.description: When true, ask Seq to include rendered event messages.

name: seq_api_catalog
description: Search the built-in official Seq route catalog by method, permission, or text before making advanced API calls.

permission.description: Optional Seq permission filter such as Public, Read, Write, Project, Organization, or System.

search.description: Case-insensitive text search across route, permission, requirements, and notes.

includeNotes.description: When true, include notes from the route catalog.

name: seq_api_live_links
description: Discover route links advertised by the connected Seq instance, useful for comparing live routes with the static catalog.

sourceFilter.description: Optional case-insensitive source route filter, for example api/events/resources.

name: seq_api_request
description: Execute an advanced Seq API request against an official cataloged route template. Use seq_api_catalog first to choose method/path.

method.description: HTTP method matching an entry from seq_api_catalog.

path.description: Official Seq route template from seq_api_catalog, for example api/events/{id}. Do not include a leading slash.

pathParams.description: Named values for route template placeholders, for example { id: 'event-123' } for api/events/{id}. Values are URL-encoded by the server.

query.description: Seq query string parameters as string values. Keep filters/time ranges/counts bounded; use the starter tools for common query shapes.

body.description: JSON-compatible request body for routes that accept one. Omit for GET routes unless the Seq API route explicitly documents a body.

contentType.description: Request Content-Type. Defaults to application/json when body is supplied.
